claims.claim: A third-party repay with an explicit amount reduces the borrower's debt and does not move their collateral.
Aave rejects type(uint256).max from a caller repaying on behalf of another account.
A repay above the debt charges the rescuer only the debt.
The repay formula carries a live Aave position to its target health factor on Base and Arbitrum forks.
In a forced price crash on a Base fork, a position rescued at its trigger is not liquidatable, and the same position left alone is liquidated and pays the bonus.
The keeper does not broadcast a transaction unless its signature recovers to the derived rescuer.

claims.claim: A keeper holding a rescue-only key repaid real Aave debt on Base Sepolia through the Levee contract on NEAR testnet and Chain Signatures.
The keeper loop detected a health factor below its trigger and completed the rescue with no manual step.

A keeper holding a key limited to rescue_from_collateral repaid real Aave debt on Base Sepolia by selling the borrower's own WETH collateral in one transaction, through LeveeUnwind, signed by the Levee v0.2 contract on NEAR testnet with Chain Signatures. No reserve was used. The Uniswap pool it sold in was seeded by us at Aave's oracle price, so its price is not a measure of slippage.
In collateral mode, the keeper loop detected a health factor below the borrower's trigger and completed the unwind from collateral with no manual step.
On Base Sepolia, when the pool's quote for the sale was worse than the borrower's slippage bound against Aave's oracle, the keeper refused before asking NEAR to sign, and nothing was sent.
LeveeUnwind refuses to sell anything while the borrower's health factor is at or above the trigger they set.
LeveeUnwind refuses a sale worse than the borrower's slippage bound against Aave's oracle, here after a large sale pushed the pool 3% away.
LeveeUnwind sells only the collateral, in only the Uniswap pool, the borrower authorized.
A sandwich around a published unwind costs the borrower about the keeper's quote tolerance more than the quote at most, not the borrower's whole slippage bound.
A keeper key limited to rescue_from_collateral is refused on every other contract method.

Neither testnet contract account, levee-core-1503.testnet (v0.1) nor levee-core-v2-1503.testnet (v0.2), has an access key: the last full-access key on each was deleted in NEAR transactions 3u8yYEBB9eVJbRGjE27xiHru1aAA4W7Mh4C2rrsZ86fu and C5aHVAahMMa3BjqddSDSf7AK8VCkuFiuqizGj7vbzJJA, at blocks 276,764,277 and 276,764,289. A collateral rescue on v0.2 landed after that, its NEAR call at block 276,764,677.
